check:
set -euo pipefail
export HOME="${HOME:-/root}"
set -a; . "${LLMAR_ENV_FILE:-/etc/llmar-runner.env}"; set +a
cd "$WORK_DIR"
if systemctl is-active --quiet llmar-check; then echo "llmar-check is already running" >&2; exit 3; fi
systemctl reset-failed llmar-check 2>/dev/null || true
systemd-run --unit=llmar-check --collect --quiet --property=KillMode=mixed --property=TimeoutStopSec=420 --property=LimitCORE=0 --working-directory="$WORK_DIR" --setenv=HOME=/root --setenv=PATH=/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin $WORK_DIR/venv/bin/python -I $WORK_DIR/repo/experiments/deepswe-harbor/driver.py check --kind both --reps 1 --concurrency 6
sleep 3; systemctl is-active llmar-check || { journalctl -u llmar-check -n 30 --no-pager -o cat; exit 1; }

export HOME="${HOME:-/root}"
set -a; . "${LLMAR_ENV_FILE:-/etc/llmar-runner.env}"; set +a

docker pull -q python:3.13-slim@sha256:09a17cad02668ae61ece136b4fd36ac3849e14f670ebedb637ea3e15580525bc >/dev/null

fleet.bootstrap:
set -euo pipefail
export HOME="${HOME:-/root}"
set -a; . "${LLMAR_ENV_FILE:-/etc/llmar-runner.env}"; set +a
cd "$WORK_DIR"

SHA=abababababababababababababababababababababababababababababababab
T=/tmp/llmar-harbor.tgz
tr -d '\n' < "$T.b64" | base64 -d > "$T"
echo "$SHA  $T" | sha256sum -c - >/dev/null || { echo "sha256 mismatch" >&2; exit 1; }
bad=$(tar -tvzf "$T" | awk '{print substr($1,1,1)}' | grep -v '^[-d]$' || true)
[ -z "$bad" ] || { echo "tarball contains links or special files" >&2; exit 1; }
if tar -tzf "$T" | grep -Ev '^(experiments/deepswe\-harbor|experiments/codex\-deepswe|packages/pricing/data)(/|$)' | grep -q .; then echo "paths outside the packed roots" >&2; exit 1; fi
if tar -tzf "$T" | grep -Eq '(^/|(^|/)\.\.(/|$))'; then echo "absolute or parent paths" >&2; exit 1; fi
umask 077
stage=$(mktemp -d "$WORK_DIR/stage.XXXXXX")
tar -xzf "$T" -C "$stage" --no-same-owner --no-same-permissions
for r in experiments/deepswe-harbor experiments/codex-deepswe packages/pricing/data; do
  mkdir -p "$WORK_DIR/repo/$r"
  find "$WORK_DIR/repo/$r" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 ! -name results ! -name data ! -name bin -exec rm -rf {} +
  cp -a "$stage/$r/." "$WORK_DIR/repo/$r/"
done
rm -rf "$stage" "$T.b64"
UV="${LLMAR_UV:-/usr/local/bin/uv}"
"$UV" venv --quiet --allow-existing --python "$DRIVER_PYTHON" "$WORK_DIR/venv"
"$UV" pip sync --quiet --python "$WORK_DIR/venv/bin/python" --require-hashes "$WORK_DIR/repo/experiments/deepswe-harbor/driver-requirements.txt"
echo "$SHA" > "$WORK_DIR/repo/.llmar-tarball-sha256"
"$WORK_DIR/venv/bin/python" -I "$WORK_DIR/repo/experiments/deepswe-harbor/driver.py" --help >/dev/null
echo "ready ${SHA:0:12} runner $RUNNER_INDEX"
